purpose: Check which tracked wild mammal individuals can be contrasted at equal photoperiod before inspecting GPS displacement outcomes; publish aggregate observation coverage only.
selection: Fixed pilot of three public, Northern Hemisphere, terrestrial wild mammal GPS packages selected from the complete Movebank Data inventory using animal count, original fix count, multiple latitudes and diet/movement ecology, not movement response results; not a global sample.
coverage_rule: At least 3 recorded locations during mean-solar daytime and nighttime on each paired calendar date; opposite June-solstice branch, daylength difference <=5 minutes, >=30 days separation; one use of each date; source observation coverage only.
output_policy: No exact locations, animal identifiers, raw trajectories, or behavioral effects in committed files/artifacts. Access failures remain source HOLD.
